arguments.type: previously dimensioned one- or two-dimensional floating-point field

arguments.name: source
arguments.type: previously dimensioned one- or two-dimensional floating-point field

semantics.summary: Transposes a square matrix in place when the source is omitted, or copies the transpose of source into destination.
side-effects: Mutates the destination field; the in-place form also reads and rewrites the same field.

notes: The two-operand form requires compatible reversed dimensions; if source is n×m, destination must be m×n.
